evidence: The crystal structure of SZO films were characterized by X-ray diffraction (Philips X’Pert Pro MPD) with a Cu Ka radiation source... The morphologies of the SZO films were characterized by field emission scanning electron microscope (Zeiss-Supra-55). Composition analysis was carried out using energy dispersive x-ray spectrometer (EDS, Oxford Instruments INCAPentaFET- 93) measurements... The chemical state of the SZO films were investigated by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS, Axis Ultra)... The electrical properties of SZO films were measured by Hall measurements (PPMS, Quantum Design)... The optical properties were obtained by transmittance spectra measured using a Shimadzu UV3100PC spectrophotometer
